```python
def pancake_sort(nums):
    arr_len = len(nums)
    while arr_len > 1:
        mi = nums.index(max(nums[:arr_len]))
        # Flip the array from the start to the max index
        nums[:mi+1] = nums[:mi+1][::-1]
        # Flip the entire array
        nums[:] = nums[::-1]
        arr_len -= 1
    return nums
```

```python
import math

def count_Odd_Squares(n, m):
```
